spec_match.rationale: Shows the MutationObserver-based fallback a developer ships today, explicitly labelled FALLBACK, with the native value documented as the replacement.

interactive.rationale: Remove-from-DOM / display:none / restore controls drive the observer and the hidden-state readout live.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Blurb promises a working fallback today; delivered and labelled.

edge_cases.rationale: Distinguishes DOM removal from display:none — exactly the subtlety the native value handles differently.

conformance.rationale: On-page suite: 2 pass · 3 fail · 1 blocked, honest for this build.

accessibility.rationale: Native controls with aria-live status; observer state changes surfaced as text.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment): every visible button clicked, aria-live output captured after each action, console and network clean on desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3, zero horizontal overflow, screenshots captured; conformance panel observed executing with honest fails on this pre-157 build.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, shared shell classes, no static-card pattern; verdict colors on light backgrounds.

telemetry_health.rationale: Demo telemetry loads; no unexpected console/runtime errors during the full click-through.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: 0px horizontal overflow and clean console at both 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800; harness-recorded state for the parent demo is ok/ok.

summary: Observer fired on each mutation ('DOM changed — observer fired', anchor valid/hidden readouts). Fallback clearly separated from native behaviour.
